title: Positive power maps of the multiplicative fppf sheaf are locally surjective
statement: Let $S$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], and let $n\geq1$ be an integer. For an $S$-scheme $T$ put $\mathbf G_m(T)=\Gamma(T,\mathcal O_T)^\times$. For every $S$-scheme $T$ and $a\in\mathbf G_m(T)$ there is a jointly surjective family $\{T_i\to T\}$ of flat locally finitely presented morphisms [def-weil-flat-morphism, def-sbc-locally-finite-presentation] and units $b_i\in\Gamma(T_i,\mathcal O_{T_i})^\times$ with $b_i^n=a|_{T_i}$. Equivalently, the map of fppf sheaves $\mathbf G_m\to\mathbf G_m$, $b\mapsto b^n$, is locally surjective. No invertibility of $n$ on $S$ is assumed.

source.place: Tag 040N, lemma-kummer-sequence-syntomic, positive-integer case and its proof; root algebra A[X]/(X^n-a). The displayed source says n in N but the proof requires n>0, as imposed here.

proof.text: Cover $T$ by its affine opens $U_i$ using [lem-weil-pbc-affine-opens-basis]. Put $A_i=\Gamma(U_i,\mathcal O_T)$ and let $a_i\in A_i^\times$ be the restriction of $a$. Use [lem-weil-pbc-affine-open-spec-points] to identify $U_i$ with $\operatorname{Spec}A_i$ inside $T$. Form $B_i=A_i[X]/(X^n-a_i)$ and the morphism $q_i:\operatorname{Spec}B_i\to U_i$ induced by $A_i\to B_i$ [def-weil-affine-spectrum]. Give its source the composite structure map to $S$.

source.place: Tag 040N, lemma-kummer-sequence-syntomic, proof, affine root algebra and covering argument, lines 2939–2966; fppf conclusion uses its explicit presentation instead of the stronger syntomic assertion.

proof.text: An empty $U_i$ can be omitted. Otherwise $A_i\ne0$, and $X^n-a_i$ is monic of degree $n$. By [lem-weil-pbc-monic-quotient-free], $B_i$ is free with basis $1,\bar X,\ldots,\bar X^{n-1}$. Consequently $A_i\to B_i$ is flat by [lem-sc-affine-standard-cover-finite-free-local-fp-flat]. For every maximal ideal $\mathfrak m\subset A_i$, the reduction clause of [lem-weil-pbc-monic-quotient-free] gives $B_i/\mathfrak mB_i\cong(A_i/\mathfrak m)[X]/(X^n-\bar a_i)$, which has the same $n$-element power basis over the nonzero field $A_i/\mathfrak m$. Since $n\ge1$, its basis vector $1$ is nonzero. Thus $\mathfrak mB_i\ne B_i$, and [lem-weil-pbc-flat-faithfully-flat-maximal-ideals] shows that $A_i\to B_i$ is faithfully flat. By [lem-weil-pbc-faithfully-flat-surjective-spectrum], $q_i$ is surjective.

source.place: Tag 040N, lemma-kummer-sequence-syntomic, proof, affine root algebra and covering argument, lines 2939–2966; fppf conclusion uses its explicit presentation instead of the stronger syntomic assertion.

proof.text: By [lem-weil-pbc-flat-ring-map-iff-flat-affine], $q_i$ is flat. The inclusion $j_i:U_i\hookrightarrow T$ has isomorphic local rings because the structure sheaf of an open subscheme is the restricted structure sheaf [def-weil-open-immersion]. An isomorphism of rings is flat: tensoring along it identifies an injective map with itself. Hence $j_i$ is flat by [def-weil-flat-morphism], and $p_i=j_iq_i$ is flat by [lem-pc-flat-compose]. The one-generator, one-relation presentation $B_i=A_i[X]/(X^n-a_i)$ proves that $p_i$ is locally of finite presentation directly by [def-sbc-locally-finite-presentation]: at each source point take the whole affine source and the affine target neighbourhood $U_i\subset T$.

source.place: Tag 040N, lemma-kummer-sequence-syntomic, proof, affine root algebra and covering argument, lines 2939–2966; fppf conclusion uses its explicit presentation instead of the stronger syntomic assertion.

proof.text: In $B_i$, let $b_i=\bar X$. The defining quotient relation is $b_i^n=a_i$. It is a unit: an explicit inverse is $a_i^{-1}\bar X^{n-1}$, since $n\ge1$ and $\bar X\cdot a_i^{-1}\bar X^{n-1}=a_i^{-1}\bar X^n=1$. Under the global-section identification for an affine spectrum [def-weil-affine-spectrum], this is a unit on $\operatorname{Spec}B_i$ whose $n$th power is $p_i^*a$.

source.place: Tag 040N, lemma-kummer-sequence-syntomic, proof, affine root algebra and covering argument, lines 2939–2966; fppf conclusion uses its explicit presentation instead of the stronger syntomic assertion.

proof.text: For any $t\in T$, choose $i$ with $t\in U_i$. The surjectivity of $q_i$ proved in step 2 gives a point of $\operatorname{Spec}B_i$ above $t$. Thus the $p_i$ are jointly surjective, and step 3 supplies exactly the flat locally finitely presented family required in the statement. Step 4 supplies its roots. For $T=\varnothing$ use the empty family. This also gives the stated local surjectivity interpretation, since that means precisely that every target section has a lift on a covering family. At no point was $n$ inverted.
